name: August Bechtel
original_name: アウグスト・ベクテル
source:
Carlson Academy third year student. Serves as the school military police chief.
Even students are treated as military personnel, and the order of the school will be cracked down by their military police.
The commander-in-chief is the student council president.
Although inferior to Karl, he is a master of hand-to-hand combat and a master of arms.

A giant warrior with a well-trained body.

[From [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=922863&gc=gcl]Getchu[/url]]
